name: aux-boot-restore
description: Half of boot to AUX; confirmed on hardware (NAV, 2026-09-28) together with aux-boot-default (and aux-autoswitch): the unit booted to AUX three times, and the SPYTAKE capture shows AUX's request with PrOnly false, POS_AUX (7, 20) in ScheduledInit, and AUX acknowledged at 10228 ms while the saved Last_Source was 1. C_MGR_SRC::AddRequest adds a type-5/6 request's (Sched_Pos, priority) to the ScheduledInit table and compares it against (Last_Source, Last_Source_Priority) only when the request's PrOnly byte (+0x28) is clear; otherwise the 7.5 s init timer falls back to the tuner. PrOnly is the bool argument of C_HMI_SrcMgntBase::ActivateSource, and AUX passes true in two places: C_HMI_MEDIA_APP_BASE::InitApp (the boot request the restore sees) and HandleAudioAuxInputStatusChnged (a re-request when the AUX input setting changes). Edits 1 and 2 make both pass false, so only AUX's requests change; edit 3 makes the restored Last_Source_Priority always 20, AUX's priority, so AUX's (7, 20) matches aux-boot-default's forced Last_Source 7. After boot, a second AUX request is forced to the front via ForceSchedulerPosition; the handler sends one only when the AUX input setting goes from zero to non-zero, so this does not switch to AUX when audio starts. NAV only. See docs/PATCHES.md#boot-to-aux-aux-boot-default-aux-boot-restore.
summary: lets AUX's `PrOnly` request reach the boot restore, and forces the restored priority to AUX's 20; pair with `aux-boot-default`

status.label: Confirmed with aux-boot-default
status.note: booted to AUX three times (2026-09-28, NAV); the spy capture shows AUX restored and acknowledged at request time

patches.why: C_HMI_MEDIA_APP_BASE::HandleAudioAuxInputStatusChnged: `li r4,1` is the PrOnly argument of C_HMI_SrcMgntBase::ActivateSource(aux, true) when the AUX input becomes available. Pass false, so AUX's request enters the ScheduledInit table and is compared against Last_Source. Scoped to AUX: the video app's own ActivateSource(true) calls are untouched.

C_HMI_MEDIA_APP_BASE::InitApp: `li r4,1` is the PrOnly argument of the boot-time ActivateSource(aux, true) - the AUX source opened with label user_HMI.AUX.Equalizer_aux, the only one of InitApp's six activations that passes true. This is the request the boot restore sees (executed: 2026-09-28 car test, AUX's request at 10109 ms still PrOnly true with the handler edit alone). Pass false.

C_MGR_SRC::StartUp: replace `lwz r0,8(r1)` (the saved Last_Source_Priority, stored to this+0xac at 0x01699448) with `li r0,20`, AUX's request priority, so the restore compares against (7, 20) whatever priority was saved.
